pr.title: refactor(gallery): extract gallery scanning and media helpers into gallery_scan.py
pr.body:
Closes #521

## Summary

Moves the gallery-scan/media helpers out of `app.py` into a new sibling module `gallery_scan.py`, following the established `thumbnails.py` / `llm_api.py` extraction pattern. Pure refactor: no scan behavior, endpoint names, URLs, env vars, or template context changes.

## Notes / Risk

- Risk: low. The one semantic subtlety is module generation in tests: `gallery_scan._app()` resolves `sys.modules["app"]` live, so any *future* bootstrap that re-imports `app` must pop `gallery_scan` with it (commented at every existing site, and in `gallery_scan.py`'s module docstring).
pr.diff:
diff --git a/gallery_scan.py b/gallery_scan.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/gallery_scan.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Gallery scanning and media helpers extracted from app.py."""
+
+import os
+
+GALLERY_SCAN_LIMIT = int(os.environ.get("GALLERY_SCAN_LIMIT", "200"))
+
+def _app():
+    import app
+    return app
+
+def iter_gallery_items():
+    return _app().DATA_FOLDER.iterdir()

linkedIssues.title: Extract gallery scanning and media helpers from app.py into gallery_scan.py
linkedIssues.body:
## Settled design decision
Move the gallery-scan helpers into new sibling module gallery_scan.py; app.py imports them. Route endpoint names ('view'/'thumb') must stay identical because media_metadata uses url_for.

## Dependencies
- Sibling extractions touching app.py must be merged sequentially to avoid merge conflicts.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] gallery_scan.py exists and contains the moved helpers and constants (code_inspection).
- [ ] tests/test_bounded_scans.py, tests/test_gallery_scan_cache.py, tests/test_find_duplicate_media.py and tests/test_recent_smoke.py pass with only import-path updates (automated_test).

from gallery_scan import iter_gallery_items, GALLERY_SCAN_LIMIT

__all__ = ["app", "iter_gallery_items", "GALLERY_SCAN_LIMIT"]
